name: Snails & fingernail clams
description: The lake's molluscs: the large grazing snail Campeloma decisum and small fingernail clams (Sphaeriidae and other bivalves). Functional group pooling the source's three mollusc taxa; in the source's gut-content records Campeloma is an extreme generalist, its scraped-biofilm diet registering everything from algae to small invertebrates.
